title: Unimodularity of the tree basis matrix of the bond space
statement: Let a finite digraph be given by its tail and head maps on a finite arc set $A$, and let $T$ be a spanning tree of this digraph. If $B$ is the integer basis matrix of the bond space corresponding to $T$ — its rows indexed by the arcs of $T$ — then $B$ is unimodular; that is, every full square submatrix of $B$ (a submatrix whose columns are picked out by an injective column selection) has determinant $0$, $+1$, or $-1$.
hypotheses_covered: T is a spanning tree of the digraph
B is the integer basis matrix of the bond space corresponding to T (rows indexed by T)
replaced: (proof due to Tutte, 1965b). \emph{The basis matrix \texttt{B} is unimodular.}
